{{Quote|Thank the Force you came, Princess. They found the Palace. The Royal Palace. It's in the Graveyard. Go to Mining Outpost 11. The report was file there. One scout also said they found &hellip; Bail Organa &hellip; hurry &hellip;|Zaz Kamiroz|<ref name="GoA" />}}
'''Zaz Kamiroz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] and member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Along with [[Hanos Darr]], he was stationed at [[Mining Outpost 11]], a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] within [[the Graveyard]] to search for valuable ores. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in an [[Operation Yavin Kill Two|effort]] to lure the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] into a trap at the site of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] destruction, released rumors to the miners that the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] had been found in the debris field. Then, the miners were ordered to leave the facility. Kamiroz and Darr traveled to the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']], using a code phrase with a local Alliance agent, the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Poliss]], to arrange a meeting with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Poliss managed to hide Kamiroz in the ship's [[Dome of the Mother Jungle]], although Darr was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[XS3]], who had been dispatched by the Empire. Kamiroz himself was attacked by another assassin, the Human female [[Ferreges]], but was rescued by a team of Alliance agents who had stumbled into the affair. Kamiroz relayed his information to the team, believing they were the Heroes of Yavin, before being sent for treatment for his wounds.
